cards.note: 正式邮件唯一安全开头。不知姓名用 Dear Sir or Madam。绝不用 Dear + 名字全称
cards.example: Dear Ms. Carter,

cards.note: 半正式（同事、熟识客户）。PTE 题干给了名字就用这个
cards.example: Dear Michael,

cards.note: 非正式（朋友、邻居）。题干是朋友/邻居场景时用，用错 register 扣 appropriacy
cards.example: Hi Sarah,

cards.note: 完全不知收件人时用。比 Dear Sir or Madam 更保险
cards.example: To whom it may concern,

cards.front: I am writing to inform you that
cards.note: 告知类万能开头。比 I want to tell you 正式得多
cards.example: I am writing to inform you that our delivery has been delayed.
cards.ipa: /aɪ əm ˈɹaɪtɪŋ tu ɪnˈfɔɹm ju ðət/

cards.front: I am writing to enquire about
cards.note: 询问类开头。美式拼 inquire，两者都接受
cards.example: I am writing to enquire about the vacancy advertised last week.

cards.front: I am writing with regard to
cards.note: 最正式的引出话题方式
cards.example: I am writing with regard to the invoice dated 3 May.

cards.front: I am writing to express my concern about
glosses: 我写信表达我对……的担忧
cards.note: 投诉类软开头，比 complain 更得体
cards.example: I am writing to express my concern about the noise from unit 4B.
cards.ipa: /aɪ əm ˈɹaɪtɪŋ tu ɪkˈspɹɛs maɪ kənˈsɝn əˈbaʊt/

cards.example: I am writing to request an extension of the deadline.

cards.front: I hope this email finds you well
cards.note: 礼貌垫句。只在半正式以上用，且不要每封都写
cards.example: I hope this email finds you well.
cards.ipa: /aɪ ˈhoʊp ðɪs ˈiˌmeɪɫ ˈfaɪndz ju ˈwɛɫ/

cards.front: Thank you for your email regarding
cards.example: Thank you for your email regarding the refund.

cards.note: 承接之前沟通，显得专业
cards.example: Further to our conversation on Monday, I am sending the figures.

cards.note: 跟进类。follow up on 是职场超高频
cards.example: I am following up on my previous request.
Please be advised that the office will close at noon.

cards.front: I would like to draw your attention to
cards.example: I would like to draw your attention to a billing error.
cards.ipa: /aɪ wəd ˈɫaɪk tə ˈdɹɔ jɝ əˈtɛnʃən tu/

cards.example: As you may be aware, the policy changed last month.

cards.front: It has come to my attention that
cards.note: 正式指出问题，不带指责
cards.example: It has come to my attention that the report is incomplete.
cards.ipa: /ɪt həz ˈkəm tə maɪ əˈtɛnʃən ðət/

cards.example: I have attached the schedule for your reference.

cards.note: 邮件公约用语，PTE 明确考 email conventions
cards.example: Please find attached a copy of the receipt.

cards.front: I would appreciate it if you could
glosses: 如果您能……我将不胜感激
cards.note: 最安全的礼貌请求句式。it 不能省
cards.example: I would appreciate it if you could confirm by Friday.
cards.ipa: /aɪ wəd əˈpɹiʃiˌeɪt ɪt ɪf ju kʊd/

cards.front: Could you please + 动词原形
cards.example: Could you please send me the updated invoice?

cards.front: I would be grateful if you could
cards.note: 与 appreciate 句式轮换，避免重复扣词汇分
cards.example: I would be grateful if you could look into this.
cards.ipa: /aɪ wəd bi ˈɡɹeɪtfəɫ ɪf ju kʊd/

cards.example: Would it be possible to reschedule the meeting?

cards.front: I am writing to ask whether
cards.example: I am writing to ask whether a replacement is available.

cards.note: 催促但不失礼，远胜 as soon as possible
cards.example: Please reply at your earliest convenience.

cards.note: 简短正式请求，慎用过多
cards.example: Kindly confirm receipt of this email.

cards.front: Please accept my sincere apologies for
glosses: 对……请接受我诚挚的歉意
cards.note: 最高级别道歉，客服场景首选
cards.example: Please accept my sincere apologies for the inconvenience.
I sincerely apologise for the delay in responding.

cards.front: I regret to inform you that
cards.example: I regret to inform you that your request was declined.

cards.front: We are sorry for any inconvenience caused
glosses: 对造成的不便我们深感抱歉
cards.example: We are sorry for any inconvenience caused.
cards.ipa: /wi ɝ ˈsɑɹi fɝ ˈɛni ˌɪnkənˈvinjəns ˈkɔzd/

cards.front: This was an oversight on our part
cards.note: 承认错误但不过度自责
cards.example: This was an oversight on our part and has now been corrected.
cards.ipa: /ðɪs wəz ən ˈoʊvɝˌsaɪt ɑn ˈaʊɝ ˈpɑɹt/

cards.example: Rest assured that this will not happen again.

cards.note: 投诉用语，比 be bad 高级
cards.example: The service fell short of our expectations.

cards.note: 正式表达不满，不要用 angry
cards.example: I am dissatisfied with the quality of the repair.

cards.note: 量化投诉，增加 content 分
cards.example: I have raised this issue on three separate occasions.
I have called twice, to no avail.
I trust you will resolve this promptly.
I am writing to seek a resolution to this matter.
I would like to request a full refund.
We are prepared to offer compensation.

cards.front: due to circumstances beyond our control
glosses: 由于我们无法控制的情况
cards.example: The event was postponed due to circumstances beyond our control.
Owing to a staff shortage, opening hours have changed.
We have revised the process with a view to avoiding further delays.
In an effort to reduce waiting times, we have hired more staff.

cards.note: suggest 后从句用原形动词（虚拟）
cards.example: I would suggest that we meet on Thursday.

cards.note: 给出方案，适合三点式 bullet
cards.example: One option would be to extend the deadline by a week.
Alternatively, you may wish to book online.
I am happy to arrange a replacement.

cards.front: If this is not convenient, please let me know
cards.note: 体贴收尾，得 appropriacy 分
cards.example: If this is not convenient, please let me know.
cards.ipa: /ɪf ðɪs ɪz ˈnɑt kənˈvinjənt ˈpɫiz ˈɫɛt mi ˈnoʊ/

cards.front: Please do not hesitate to contact me
cards.note: 结尾万能句，hesitate 拼写易错
cards.example: Please do not hesitate to contact me if you need further details.
cards.ipa: /ˈpɫiz du ˈnɑt ˈhɛzəˌteɪt tə ˈkɑnˌtækt mi/

cards.front: I look forward to hearing from you
cards.note: look forward to 后接 V-ing，绝不接原形
cards.example: I look forward to hearing from you.
cards.ipa: /aɪ ˈɫʊk ˈfɔɹwɝd tə ˈhɪɹɪŋ fɹəm ju/

cards.example: I await your response.

cards.front: Thank you for your time and consideration
cards.example: Thank you for your time and consideration.
cards.ipa: /ˈθæŋk ju fɝ jɝ ˈtaɪm ən kənˌsɪdɝˈeɪʃən/

cards.front: Thank you in advance for your assistance
cards.example: Thank you in advance for your assistance.
cards.ipa: /ˈθæŋk ju ɪn ədˈvæns fɝ jɝ əˈsɪstəns/

cards.note: 知道收件人姓名时用（英式规则）
cards.example: Yours sincerely, Jian Zhou

cards.note: 不知姓名（Dear Sir or Madam）时用
cards.example: Yours faithfully, Jian Zhou

cards.note: 半正式最安全，北美职场默认
cards.example: Kind regards, Jian

cards.note: 与 Kind regards 等价，轮换使用
cards.example: Best regards, Jian
Warm regards, Jian

cards.note: 口语开场垫句，争取思考时间且自然
cards.example: Thanks for letting me know — I really appreciate the heads-up.

cards.front: I really appreciate you asking me
cards.example: I really appreciate you asking me, but unfortunately…
That's a good point, and I'd like to add something.

cards.front: Let me see what I can do
cards.note: 被请求帮忙时的自然回应
cards.example: Let me see what I can do about that.
cards.ipa: /ˈɫɛt mi ˈsi wət aɪ kən ˈdu/

cards.front: I can understand why you feel that way
glosses: 我理解你为什么这么想
cards.note: 共情句，投诉/冲突场景必备
cards.example: I can completely understand why you feel that way.
cards.ipa: /aɪ kən ˌəndɝˈstænd ˈwaɪ ju ˈfiɫ ˈðæt ˈweɪ/

cards.front: I'm afraid I won't be able to
cards.note: 标准礼貌拒绝，不要直接说 I can't
cards.example: I'm afraid I won't be able to make it on Saturday.
cards.ipa: /aɪm əˈfɹeɪd aɪ ˈwoʊnt bi ˈeɪbəɫ tə/

cards.example: Unfortunately, I've already committed to another event that day.
I'd love to, but I have a prior engagement.

cards.note: 拒绝邀约的万能理由，不必编细节
cards.example: I have a prior engagement that evening.

cards.front: Can I take a rain check?
cards.note: 北美超高频口语，改期的地道说法
cards.example: Can I take a rain check on that?

cards.front: Would it be okay if we postponed it?
cards.example: Would it be okay if we postponed it to next week?
cards.ipa: /wʊd ɪt bi ˌoʊˈkeɪ ɪf wi poʊstˈpoʊnd ɪt/

cards.note: 口语道歉开场，比 sorry 有分量
cards.example: I owe you an apology for missing the meeting.

cards.front: I'm so sorry for the mix-up
cards.example: I'm so sorry for the mix-up with the booking.
I'm sorry — it completely slipped my mind.

cards.front: Let me make it up to you
cards.note: 道歉后提补救，得 appropriacy 分
cards.example: Let me make it up to you — coffee's on me.
cards.ipa: /ˈɫɛt mi ˈmeɪk ɪt ˈəp tə ju/

cards.example: I take full responsibility for the error.

cards.note: 最礼貌请求。注意后接 V-ing，且回答 No 才是答应
cards.example: Would you mind keeping the noise down after ten?

cards.front: I was wondering if you could
cards.example: I was wondering if you could cover my shift on Friday.

cards.front: Do you think you could possibly
cards.example: Do you think you could possibly give me a hand?

cards.front: Is there any chance you could
cards.example: Is there any chance you could move your car?

cards.front: I'd really appreciate it if you could
glosses: 你要是能……我真的很感激
cards.example: I'd really appreciate it if you could let me know today.
cards.ipa: /aɪd ˈɹɪɫi əˈpɹiʃiˌeɪt ɪt ɪf ju kʊd/

cards.note: 非正式求助，朋友同事场景
cards.example: Could you give me a hand with these boxes?

cards.note: 虚拟语气建议句，考官爱听的语法点
cards.example: If I were you, I'd speak to the supervisor directly.
You might want to consider booking in advance.
Have you thought about asking for a transfer?
It might be worth checking the warranty first.

cards.note: 清楚引出建议，方便展开
cards.example: What I'd suggest is that we split the task.

cards.note: 接受别人道歉的标准回应
cards.example: Don't worry about it — these things happen.
No harm done. These things happen.
It's fine, no harm done.
Try not to stress — I'm sure it'll work out.

cards.front: Let me know if there's anything I can do
glosses: 有什么我能帮的告诉我
cards.example: Let me know if there's anything I can do to help.
cards.ipa: /ˈɫɛt mi ˈnoʊ ɪf ðɝz ˈɛniˌθɪŋ aɪ kən ˈdu/

cards.front: I don't mean to complain, but
cards.note: 软化投诉开场，保住 appropriacy
cards.example: I don't mean to complain, but the heating still isn't working.

cards.front: I wanted to bring something to your attention
cards.example: I wanted to bring something to your attention about the schedule.
cards.ipa: /aɪ ˈwɑntɪd tə ˈbɹɪŋ ˈsəmθɪŋ tə jɝ əˈtɛnʃən/

cards.front: It's been going on for a while now
cards.example: It's been going on for a while now and it's affecting my sleep.
cards.ipa: /ɪts bɪn ˈɡoʊɪŋ ˈɑn fɝ ə ˈwaɪɫ ˈnaʊ/

cards.front: Is there any way we could sort this out?
cards.note: 投诉后导向解决，高分收尾
cards.example: Is there any way we could sort this out today?
cards.ipa: /ɪz ðɝ ˈɛni ˈweɪ wi kəd ˈsɔɹt ðɪs ˈaʊt/

cards.note: 注意介词是 on 不是 for
cards.example: Congratulations on your promotion!
That's fantastic news — I'm so happy for you!

cards.front: You really went above and beyond
cards.example: You really went above and beyond on this project.
I can't thank you enough for stepping in.

cards.front: That means a lot to me
cards.example: Thank you — that means a lot to me.
How about Thursday at two? Does that work for you?

cards.front: Just let me know either way
glosses: 不管怎样都告诉我一声
cards.example: Just let me know either way by tomorrow.
I'll look into it and keep you posted.

cards.front: I'll get back to you on that
cards.example: Let me check the dates and I'll get back to you on that.
cards.ipa: /aɪɫ ˈɡɛt ˈbæk tə ju ɑn ˈðæt/

cards.note: 开场一句必须报图型，漏了扣 content 分
cards.example: The bar chart compares sales across four regions.
The line graph illustrates changes in rainfall from 2010 to 2020.
The pie chart shows the breakdown of household spending.
The flow chart outlines the recycling process.
The table presents figures for five product lines.

cards.note: PTE Core 常考建筑平面与社区地图
cards.example: The map shows the layout of the community centre.

cards.note: Core 特有的生活类图片，要读出标题和关键信息
cards.example: The poster advertises a free vaccination clinic.
The x-axis represents years and the y-axis shows revenue in dollars.
The chart illustrates how energy use varies by season.
The diagram provides an overview of the application procedure.
The data is broken down by age group.

cards.note: 最基础，务必搭配副词避免重复
cards.example: Sales rose steadily throughout the year.
Attendance climbed to 4,000 in June.
Demand surged after the announcement.
House prices soared by 30 percent.
Business picked up in the final quarter.
Enrolment fell sharply after 2018.
The figure dropped to just 12 percent.
Profits plummeted in the second half.
There was a slight dip in March.
Participation tapered off towards the end.
Numbers levelled off at around 500.
The trend plateaued after 2015.
Temperatures fluctuated between 5 and 15 degrees.
Costs rose dramatically in one year.
Membership grew steadily over the decade.
Output fell marginally in the last month.
Waiting times decreased considerably.

cards.note: 必说极值，是 content 得分点
cards.example: Sales reached a peak of 8,000 units in July.
The figure bottomed out at 200 in January.
Housing accounts for 35 percent of total spending.
Seniors make up nearly a quarter of users.
Female participants outnumbered male participants.
There were twice as many visitors as in the previous year.
In contrast to the city centre, the suburbs saw little change.

cards.note: 对比连接词，写作口语通用
cards.example: Sales grew in the north, whereas they fell in the south.
Overall, it is clear that demand has risen over the period.
The author argues that remote work improves retention.
The report claims that costs will fall.
The article highlights the shortage of skilled workers.
The passage outlines three approaches to the problem.
The speaker emphasised the need for early intervention.
The decline is attributed to rising interest rates.

The author proposes a phased rollout.
The text examines the causes of urban sprawl.

Despite the drawbacks, the scheme has proved popular.
Several factors contributed to the outcome.

cards.note: SWT 一句话压缩的关键从句
cards.example: …, which suggests that the policy is working.

cards.note: 让步结构，一句话内装两个要点
cards.example: Although costs have risen, demand remains strong.
While acknowledging the risks, the author supports the plan.

In addition to training, staff received a bonus.

cards.note: 纠正误解，不等于 on the other hand
cards.example: It did not fail; on the contrary, it exceeded targets.

cards.note: 后接名词或 V-ing，绝不接从句
cards.example: Despite the cost, the project went ahead.
Demand fell and, consequently, prices dropped.
The data is limited; therefore, the results are tentative.
Given that resources are limited, priorities must be set.

cards.note: for instance 后跟句子，such as 后跟名词
cards.example: Basic services, such as water and heating, were restored.
In short, the benefits outweigh the costs.

cards.note: 北美说 posting，英国说 advert
cards.example: I saw the job posting on the company website.
There is an opening in the finance team.

cards.note: 北美用 résumé，CV 指学术长简历
cards.example: Please attach your résumé and a cover letter.
Her cover letter was tailored to the role.

cards.note: 介词是 for；apply to 接公司
cards.example: I would like to apply for the position of office coordinator.
Only five applicants were shortlisted.

cards.note: 固定搭配，不说 job test
cards.example: I have a job interview on Tuesday morning.
She has the qualifications required for the role.

cards.note: 集体名词，不加 s，不说 a staff
